CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 3499.

CONFIDENTIAL.

SHANGHAI, November 20th 1929.

Sir,

I wish to acknowledge receipt of your letter
of the 19th instant, No. D. 501, containing information
regarding A.P. HIJAI and V.G. ZUROVITCH, and beg leave
to tender you my sincere thanks for the valuable parti-
culars you were good enough to place at my disposal.

I have the honour to be,

Sir,

Your obedient servant,

Consul General.

The Director,
the Criminal Investigation Department,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C.I.D. REGISTRY I.C.L...501... ...2/..11..29）

（印：RECEIVED MUNICIPAL COUNCIL REGISTRY No. 501 19.11.29）

SECRET & CONFIDENTIAL

November 19, 9

Sir,

A. P. MIHAI and V.G. PETROVICH.

With reference to your letter of November 13
regarding the above mentioned individuals, the
records of the Municipal Police show that Alexander
Mihai was charged at Shanghai with robbery on June
23, 1926 and sentenced to 3 months' imprisonment and
expulsion. Mihai, who was born in Moscow about 30
years ago, is a man of Gipsy origin and a dancer by
profession.

Vasily Petrovich was charged at Shanghai with
shoplifting on February 21, 1928 and sentenced to
3 months' imprisonment. Petrovich, who was born in
Persia, is about 29 years old. He is also of Gipsy
origin and a dancer by profession.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
A/ Director of Criminal Investigation.

Consul General for the Netherlands,
Shanghai.

（手写签名）

秘密且机密

1929年11月19日

先生：

A. P. MIHAI 和 V.G. PETROVICH。

关于阁下11月13日就上述人员去信的查询，工部局警务处记录显示，Alexander Mihai 于1926年6月23日在上海被控抢劫罪，判处监禁三个月并驱逐出境。Mihai 约30年前出生于莫斯科，具有吉普赛人血统，职业为舞蹈演员。

Vasily Petrovich 于1928年2月21日在上海被控商店行窃罪，判处监禁三个月。Petrovich 出生于波斯，现年约29岁。他也具有吉普赛人血统，职业为舞蹈演员。

此致

敬礼

您的顺从仆人，
（签名）
代理刑事侦缉处处长。

致：
荷兰驻上海总领事

（手写签名）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Foreign Section Station,
REPORT
Date November 18, 1929
Subject (in full) A.P. Mihai and V.G. Petrovich.
Made by D.S. Ovsianikoff. Forwarded by Tho Robertson, C.D. 1.
Sir,
With reference to the attached letter from the
Netherlands Consulate General dated November 13, 1929
re: Mr. A.P. Mihai and Mr. V.G. Petrovich, inquiries go
to show that Alexander Mihai, Russian Gipsy, 30 years
of age, born in Moscow, dancer by profession, was charged
with robbery on 23.6.26 and sentenced to 3 months'
imprisonment and expulsion.
Vasily Petrovich, Russian Gipsy, 29 years of age,
born in Persia, dancer by profession, was charged with
shoplifting on 21.2.28 and sentenced to 3 months'
imprisonment.
There is nothing further in Police records
concerning them.
V. Ovsianikoff
D. S.
A/D. C. I.
Reg.

18/11/29.

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.
No. 3434.

SHANGHAI, 13th November 1929.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / C.I.D. REGISTRY / No. L. O. D. 50... / ...14.11.29）

Sir,

I venture to enquire whether your Department possesses
any information regarding two Rumanians (or Russians ?)
called A. P. Mihai and V. G. Petrovich, now staying at Macao,
who have applied to the Netherlands Consul General in Hong-
kong for a visa to the Netherlands East Indies. They intend
to go as pedlars and in that capacity also to visit the
interior of outlying districts, which all seems very strange
and suspect.

Mihai, who is married, and seems to have some funds,
possesses a passport issued by the Commissioner of Foreign
Affairs for Kiangsu, dated July 29th 1929, No. 461. He is
about 30 years of age and states to be born at Bukarest.

Concerning Petrovitch I have no information but that
he has an expired passport issued by the Commissioner of
Foreign Affairs at Canton.

Thanking you in anticipation of your kind attention
to this matter,

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

（签名）
Consul General.

The Director
Criminal Investigation Department,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
SHANGHAI.

（手写批注：To Sec / ? pppr / sea / 14/11）

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号：HOLLANDIA
第 3434 号。

上海，1929年11月13日。

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / C.I.D. REGISTRY / No. L. O. D. 50... / ...14.11.29）

先生：

冒昧询问贵处是否掌握有关两名罗马尼亚人（或是俄罗斯人？）A. P. Mihai 和 V. G. Petrovich 的任何信息，此二人现居澳门，已向荷兰驻香港总领事申请前往荷属东印度的签证。他们打算以流动小贩身份前往，并以此身份走访偏远地区的内陆，这一切似乎非常奇怪且可疑。

Mihai 已婚，似乎拥有一些资金，持有江苏交涉员于1929年7月29日签发的护照，编号461。他现年约30岁，自称出生于布加勒斯特。

关于 Petrovitch，我除知悉其持有一本由广州交涉员签发的已过期护照外，别无其他信息。

预先感谢阁下对此事的关注，

此致

敬礼

您的顺从仆人，

（签名）
总领事。

致：
上海公共租界工部局
刑事侦缉处处长
上海

（手写批注：To Sec / ? pppr / sea / 14/11）
